text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, by any chance...
Could it possibly be...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Is it possible that I might actually be an even more amazing Umamusume than I thought?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then even in the Arima Kinen
where super-strong Umamusume gatherâ?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I might actually do pretty well!

Thanks to her strong performance in the Kikuka Sho,
Hishi Miracle had grown somewhat confident.

I don't know how far she can go.
Even so, with great expectations, I decided to send her off.
(WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Such huge cheers~! As expected of a stage packed with popular Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There are... a lot of candidates to watch.
A lot of them... But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And the Umamusume drawing the most eyes among them is...?
Could it be, just perhaps... could it beee~?!
(WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, of course it's that one~.
After all, she's a Tenno Sho Umamusume in her Classic year, right?

Symboli Kris S. Her out-of-this-world ability
had been thoroughly proven in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I lost... She's still in the Classic Class,
so how could she run like this...?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Class does not matter.
All that matters—is taking the shot.

Claiming victory by surpassing the great Narita Top Road.
With an unconventional rotation,
he brilliantly stole the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I know Kris S-chan is amazing.
But~ I'd like people to pay
a little attention to me too, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I should have put up a decent amount of brilliance too.
Even if it's just one or two people,
surely someone could look my way...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Put her aside! She's always like that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to steal away some of the fans' eyes.
Even just a little bit from Kris S-chan~!
